resources.string: MarryMatch is exclusively available to people currently residing in Germany. We verify your location once to confirm eligibility under GDPR rules. We never store your exact GPS position.
MarryMatch is not available in your area yet.
We currently only accept registrations within Germany. When we expand to your country, we will let you know!
Location access is required to verify that you are currently in Germany. Please grant location permission to proceed.
Unable to get fresh GPS location. Please ensure location services are enabled and try again.
Could not connect to server. Please check your internet connection and try again.
Mock or simulated location detected. MarryMatch requires authentic device location.
GDPR Privacy Notice: Exact GPS coordinates are never stored or logged. They are discarded immediately after checking eligibility.
